reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is circular (rapid heating/cooling suppresses phase separation, which is the definition of the outcome) and does not explain why some rapid methods fail or why phase separation occurs in some systems, making it scientifically weak.
reasons.testability: The proposed test compares rapid vs. conventional methods but the falsification criterion (uniform size/surface area) does not directly test the claimed mechanism of entropy-driven stabilization or phase separation suppression.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis merely restates the known benefit of rapid synthesis without offering a mechanistic insight into what governs success across different multimetal systems, so it adds little value for a researcher.
